actions.desc: The hill giant bumps its stomach, hip, shoulder, knee, or other part of its body into a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant and knocked prone.

actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +8 к попаданию, досягаемость 10 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 14 (2к8+5) дробящего урона плюс 5 (2к4) колющего урона.

traits.desc: The hill giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.
